title: Computer Vision for Driver Monitoring Systems
research_problem: Introduction to CV for ADAS
key_findings: Basic face and gaze detection mechanics

title: Driver Distraction Detection Tutorial (sWPNm_GhhCA)
research_problem: Implementing CNN for driver distraction
key_findings: State farm dataset is 2D and prone to background bias
relevance_to_prok53: Highlights overfitting risks in naive 2D classification

title: YOLO Object Detection (59XV4o8hOBk)
research_problem: Real-time object detection
key_findings: YOLO trades some bounding box precision for extreme speed
limitations: General objects, not specific to in-cabin

title: Seatbelt Detection OpenCV/YOLO (ULE78ME1ckQ)
research_problem: Detecting seatbelts via CV
key_findings: Cropping to the chest region improves seatbelt classification

title: Multi-Object Tracking (9SXPnnhvn5o)
research_problem: Tracking objects across frames
key_findings: Kalman filters fail during long occlusions

title: Action Recognition (TsI5FDUyn-I)
research_problem: Spatio-temporal action recognition
key_findings: Temporal context is key for action vs posture
relevance_to_prok53: Supports tracking+hysteresis as a lightweight alternative to 3D CNNs

title: Deep Learning for ADAS (Uz2pgATBDPA)
research_problem: Edge deployment of AI models
key_findings: Quantization is necessary for edge deployment

title: Driver Inattention Monitoring System for Intelligent Vehicles: A Review
authors: Y. Dong, Z. Hu, K. Uchimura, N. Murayama
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
research_problem: Taxonomy of driver distraction and fatigue
key_findings: False alarms must be minimized for user acceptance
Multimodal context improves reliability

title: DeepSafeDrive: A Grammar-Aware Driver Parsing Approach to Driver Behavioral Situational Awareness
authors: T. H. N. Le et al.
research_problem: Driver behavior parsing via spatial relations
key_findings: Body part relationships strongly encode distraction
Spatial grammar improves over flat classification

title: Drive&Act: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Fine-Grained Driver Behavior Recognition in Autonomous Vehicles
research_problem: Fine-grained driver behavior dataset lacking multiple views
key_findings: Cross-view generalization significantly degrades accuracy
Hierarchical temporal actions better define behavior

title: NADS-Net: A Nimble Architecture for Driver and Seat Belt Detection via Convolutional Neural Networks
research_problem: Simultaneous detection of driver and seatbelt usage
key_findings: Localizing the driver before assessing the seatbelt significantly reduces false positives
limitations: Does not explicitly model uncertain occlusions
relevance_to_prok53: Bounding box regression + semantic classifier coupling
already_implemented: Upper-body ROI followed by 3-state seatbelt classifier

title: Robust Seatbelt Detection and Usage Recognition for Driver Monitoring Systems
research_problem: Hard negative edge cases in seatbelt detection
key_findings: Hair occlusion, black clothing, and incorrect strap routing dominate failures
relevance_to_prok53: Hard negative taxonomy and definition of UNCERTAIN_OR_OCCLUDED class

title: Detecting and recognizing driver distraction through various data modality using machine learning: A review, recent advances, simplified framework and open challenges (2014–2021)
authors: J. J. Khan, A. K. M. M. Islam et al.
research_problem: Comprehensive review of multi-modal machine learning for DMS (2014-2021)
key_findings: Single modality suffers from poor illumination generalization
Simplified frameworks combining vehicle data and vision are highly effective
limitations: Focuses heavily on older ML methods vs modern transformers
relevance_to_prok53: Validates the need for robust generalization metrics and framework-level design

title: Deep learning for distracted driving recognition with multisource data: A comprehensive review
research_problem: Transformers and GNNs in multi-source DMS
key_findings: Transformers excel in long-term temporal reasoning but are hard to deploy on edge due to parameter count
relevance_to_prok53: Confirms that complex architectures block edge inference; validates YOLO+TemporalEngine baseline approach.
already_implemented: TemporalEventEngine for temporal reasoning without heavy Transformer cost

title: Cross-Camera Distracted Driver Classification Through Feature Disentanglement and Contrastive Learning
authors: Luigi Celona, Simone Bianco, Paolo Napoletano
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
research_problem: Camera-view domain shift in DMS
key_findings: Domain shift drops accuracy by 20-30%
Feature disentanglement restores generalization
relevance_to_prok53: Cross-camera external test evaluation is essential

title: Temporal Driver Action Localization Using Action Classification Methods
authors: M. A. R. E. M. et al.
research_problem: Untrimmed video event localization for driving
key_findings: Action classification per frame followed by smoothing effectively localizes events without needing complex 3D tracking

title: ByteTrack: Multi-Object Tracking by Associating Every Detection Box
research_problem: High fragmentation in MOT due to thresholding out low-confidence boxes
key_findings: Associating low-confidence boxes recovers occluded objects and reduces ID fragmentation
limitations: Relies purely on IoU (no re-ID appearance model by default)

title: Driver crash risk factors and prevalence evaluation using naturalistic driving data
research_problem: Real-world risk quantification of driver distraction
key_findings: Handheld cell phone use increases crash risk by 3.6x
Visual-manual distraction is the primary risk factor
limitations: Epidemiological study, not a CV paper
relevance_to_prok53: Grounds the distinction between physical phone and handheld-use violation
already_implemented: Separation of physical phone detection from phone-use violation behavior

title: Real-time driver distraction detection using a lightweight deep learning architecture
authors: A. H. M. S. Islam et al.
research_problem: Reducing computational overhead in DMS
key_findings: Lightweight backbones with spatial attention achieve >98% accuracy on standard datasets while maintaining high FPS on edge devices
limitations: Only tested on RGB images, lacks night-vision IR
relevance_to_prok53: Validates the choice of lightweight YOLO architectures over heavy two-stage detectors.

title: A Comprehensive Survey of Vision-Based Human Action Recognition for ADAS
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
research_problem: Review of HAR in ADAS contexts
key_findings: Pose estimation and contextual object relationships are critical for avoiding false positives in action recognition.
relevance_to_prok53: Validates the object+pose relation mapping logic for seatbelts and phones.

title: Driver Distraction Detection Based on Multi-Scale Domain Adaptation
research_problem: Domain shift across different vehicles and lighting
key_findings: Multi-scale feature adaptation significantly minimizes performance drop across unseen vehicle cabins.
relevance_to_prok53: Domain adaptation is critical for robust deployment.
potential_gap: Lack of explicit domain-adversarial loss in V2 baseline

title: Seatbelt usage detection using YOLOv5 and data augmentation techniques
research_problem: Seatbelt detection accuracy under occlusion
key_findings: Mosaic and MixUp augmentations improve detection of occluded seatbelts by 12%

title: Vision-based Driver Monitoring System for Drowsiness and Distraction
research_problem: Simultaneous detection of drowsiness and visual distraction
key_findings: Multi-task learning shares features effectively, improving speed without sacrificing accuracy.
limitations: Only covers head pose and eye states, not seatbelts or phones.

title: Real-Time Driver Seatbelt Detection Using Deep Learning
authors: S. H. Lee, Y. K. Kim
research_problem: Accurate seatbelt classification on embedded devices
key_findings: Cropping the driver torso before classification yields 15% better precision than global image detection.
relevance_to_prok53: Confirms the V2 design of CabinLocalizer -> Occupant -> Seatbelt Classifier.

title: PoseViNet: Distracted driver action recognition framework using multi-view pose estimation and vision transformer
research_problem: Multi-view action recognition
key_findings: Pose keypoints fed into a ViT provide highly robust action recognition invariant to the camera angle.
limitations: High latency, not suitable for basic edge hardware.
relevance_to_prok53: Shows that pose helps generalization, but ViT is too heavy.

title: Driver Distraction Detection via Multi-Scale Domain Adaptation Network
research_problem: Cross-domain adaptation for ADAS
key_findings: Domain shift is the leading cause of false positives in production ADAS.
limitations: Requires target domain data during training.

title: L-TLA: A lightweight driver distraction detection method based on three-level attention mechanisms
research_problem: Balancing model efficiency and detection accuracy with attention
key_findings: Attention mechanisms (Channel, Spatial, Pixel) significantly boost detection of small objects like cell phones without large parameter increases.
relevance_to_prok53: Potential improvement for small phone objects.

title: An Ensemble Learning Approach for Robust Driver Monitoring System
research_problem: Reducing false positives in IoT connected vehicles
key_findings: Ensembling multiple lightweight models yields better reliability than one massive model.
already_implemented: Separation of phone, seatbelt, and cabin models.

title: Spiking-DD: Neuromorphic event camera based driver distraction detection with spiking neural network
research_problem: High latency and power consumption in traditional vision
key_findings: Neuromorphic cameras provide extreme low latency for fast movements.

title: Distracted Driver Detection Using YOLOv8 and Attention Mechanisms
research_problem: Improving real-time detection of small items (phones, cigarettes)
key_findings: YOLOv8 integrated with CBAM attention module increases mAP for small objects by 4.2%.

title: Benchmarking YOLO-Based Deep Learning Models for Real-Time Object Detection in Hybrid ADAS
research_problem: Comparing YOLO versions for ADAS
key_findings: YOLO11s offers the best Pareto optimal trade-off between mAP and edge FPS.
relevance_to_prok53: Strong justification for YOLO11s base weights.

title: Driver Monitoring Systems: A Study on Seatbelt Detection Accuracy Under Variable Illumination
research_problem: Seatbelt detection failure in low light and glare
key_findings: Variable illumination drops recall by 35%. Adaptive histogram equalization before detection restores 25%.
relevance_to_prok53: Need for hard negatives (glare, dark) in the dataset.
already_implemented: Hard negatives included in Review 1 queue.

title: Multi-modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Driver Behavior Monitoring
research_problem: Overcoming camera occlusion in ADAS
key_findings: Fusing mmWave radar data with RGB prevents false negatives when the driver is visually occluded.
relevance_to_prok53: Out of scope for purely vision-based V2 pipeline.
